[vc_row][vc_column][eikra-vc-text-title style="style2" title="Institution's Innovation Council (IIC)"][/eikra-vc-text-title][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_tta_accordion active_section="-1" collapsible_all="true"][vc_tta_section title="ABOUT IIC" tab_id="1652100642791-92bc398c-128f"][vc_column_text]

The Ministry of Education (MoE), Govt. of India has established ‘MoE’s Innovation Cell (MIC)’ to systematically foster the culture of Innovation amongst all Higher Education Institutions (HEIs). The primary mandate of MIC is to encourage, inspire and nurture young students by supporting them to work with new ideas and transform them into prototypes while they are informative years.

MIC has envisioned encouraging creation of ‘Institution’s Innovation Council (IICs)’ across selected HEIs. A network of these IICs will be established to promote innovation in the Institution through multitudinous modes leading to an innovation promotion eco-system in the campuses.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="IIC OBJECTIVES" tab_id="1652100642804-1dbaee75-8850"][vc_column_text]
  • To create a vibrant local innovation ecosystem. Start-up supporting Mechanism in HEIs. 
  • Prepare institute for Atal Ranking of Institutions on Innovation Achievements Framework.
  • Establish Function Ecosystem for Scouting Ideas and Pre-incubation of Ideas. Develop better Cognitive Ability for Technology Students.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="IIC COUNCIL MEMBERS DETAILS – 2023-24" tab_id="1667472307204-098a9842-0030"][vc_column_text]

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="FUNCTIONS OF IICs" tab_id="1652100732751-d1523fa7-af57"][vc_column_text]
  • To conduct various innovation and entrepreneurship-related activities prescribed by Central MIC in time bound fashion.
  • Identify and reward innovations and share success stories.
  • Organize periodic workshops/ seminars/ interactions with entrepreneurs, investors, professionals and create a mentor pool for student innovators.
  • Network with peers and national entrepreneurship development organizations.
  • Create an Institution’s Innovation portal to highlight innovative projects carried out by institution’s faculty and students.
  • Organize Hackathons, idea competition, mini-challenges etc. with the involvement of industries.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="OPPORTUNITIES THROUGH IIC" tab_id="1652100773600-b0527834-3884"][vc_column_text]
  • No major capital investment required for establishing IIC as it will make use of existing local ecosystem.
  • Students/Faculty associated with IIC will get exclusive opportunity to participate in various Innovation related initiatives and competitions organized by MHRD.
  • Win exciting Prizes/Certificates every month.
  • Meet/Interact with renowned Business Leaders and top-notch academicians.
  • Opportunity to nurture and prototype new ideas.
  • Mentoring by Industry Professionals.
  • Experimentation with new/latest technologies.
  • Visit new places and learn a new culture.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="IIC EVENTS" tab_id="1661949521833-7dafa751-b0ac"][vc_column_text]
